---
title: "Who are you writing code for, supporting with your code or providing services to?"
question_id: currentWork2qcl
---

```{r}
#| include: false
#| file: ../R/_load_common.R
```

```{r}
#| echo: false
question_code <- "currentWork2qcl"

nordic_countries <- c(
  "Finland", "Norway", "Sweden", "Denmark", "Iceland", "Estonia"
)
country_groups <- list(
  Nordics = nordic_countries,
  Germany = "Germany",
  Netherlands = "Netherlands"
)
plot_countries <- countries_from_groups(country_groups)
```

### Free-text responses

```{r}

  question_code = "currentWork2qcl",
  recode_map = currentWork2qcl_recode_map,
  header = "User Group",

data_coded$summary_table
```
